# User Journeys and Core Functionality

This document outlines the main user journeys and functionality within the Chess Opening Explorer. Use this as a reference for feature completeness, E2E test planning, and product roadmap.

## 1. Discover Openings (Landing Page)
The entry point for finding new openings and managing personal repertoire.

### Search & Discovery
- **Natural Language & Semantic Search**: Find openings by descriptive themes (e.g., "aggressive gambit for white") via server-side `/api/openings/semantic-search`.
- **Global Header Search**: Instant, debounced fuzzy search for specific opening names using a lightweight search index.
- **PGN Identification**: Paste complete PGN move sequences to identify the deepest matching opening in the database.
- **"Surprise Me"**: Navigate to a random, high-quality opening from the database.
- **Popularity Showcase**: View the "Most Popular" openings based on real-time Lichess master game statistics.
- **Site Statistics**: Visibility into database coverage and total analyzed positions.

### Repertoire Management
- **Personal Repertoire**: Star openings to save them to a local "Starred" list (stored in LocalStorage).
- **Manage Saved Openings**: View, navigate to, or remove openings from your repertoire directly from the landing page.

---

## 2. Opening Detail Page
The dedicated learning environment for mastering a specific position.

### Move Mastery
- **Mainline Move Navigation**: Interactive chessboard with a list of historical moves for quick navigation.
- **Practice Mode (Move Trainer)**:
  - **Interactive Play**: Play through the opening sequence with real-time feedback (accepts correct moves, rejects others).
  - **Perspective Flip**: Practice as either White or Black with board flip support.
  - **Dynamic Hint System**: Receive visual "amber" hints if stuck (automatically triggers after 2 incorrect attempts).
  - **Sensory Feedback**: Audio feedback for moves and completions, plus Lichess-style visual move indicators.
  - **Mobile-First UX**: Full "Tap-to-Move" support for mobile devices.

### Strategic Content
- **AI-Enriched Insights**: Detailed descriptions, strategic themes, and common plans generated by LLMs.
- **Classification Metadata**: Instant identification of position type (Mainline, Variation, Sideline) and ECO/SCID codes.
- **Tags & Attributes**: Visualization of complexity, tactical nature, and typical player style suited for the opening.

### Tabbed Resource Learning
- **Overview**: High-level win rate statistics and move progression.
- **Plans**: Deep dive into strategic themes and common goals for both sides.
- **Studies Gallery**: Curated Lichess study chapters matched by FEN position (6,100+ chapters).
- **Video Gallery**: Hand-picked YouTube videos from top educators matched to the exact position.

### Navigation & Feedback
- **Hierarchical "Teasers"**: Inline expandable explorer to see sub-variations or navigate back to the Mainline.
- **External Deep Links**: Quick navigation to Lichess (Play/Analysis) or Chessable.
- **Community Feedback**: Report errors in moves or AI content via the feedback section.

---

## 3. Analyse Games Page (Personal Explorer)
Connect your real-game performance with the opening database.

### Data Integration
- **Personal History Import**: One-click import from Chess.com or Lichess by username.
- **Smart Filtering**: Automatically identifies Rated Rapid, Blitz, and Classical games (excluding Bullet and variants).

### Performance Insights
- **Color-Based Performance**: Compare your winning percentages as White vs. Black.
- **Strengths & Weaknesses**: Identification of "Highest Win Rate" openings vs. those "Needing Work" (based on personal history).
- **Traffic Analysis**: Breakdown of Top 10 most played openings to identify your true "main lines."

### Improvement Loop
- **Contextual Study**: Click any opening in your personal stats to go straight to the **Opening Detail Page** to practice the correct mainline.
- **Deep Historical Search**: Direct links back to the original platform to see all your games in a specific line.
